jobs.title: Account Executive / Account Manager, Go-to-Market
jobs.description: About Axial Axial is the trusted online M&A deal sourcing platform for professional acquirers and sellers of privately held small businesses. We have built a pioneering digital transaction platform that radically improves the speed, confidentiality, and success by which small businesses hire M&A advisors, engage with potential acquirers, and achieve successful exits. In 2025, over 13,000 lower middle market businesses pursued M&A via the Axial platform, leading to over 1,000,000 platform connections, 75,000+ signed NDAs, and hundreds of millions of dollars in successfully closed transactions (https://www.axial.net/closed-deals/).   What will you be doing?  The go-to-market (GTM) team is Axial’s sales and account management organization, focused on winning new business and growing our existing relationships across the “sell-side” (investment banks, M&A advisors, business brokers, and business owners) and “buy-side” (private equity, family offices, corporate development, independent private equity sponsors & search funds). The team comprises account executive and account management professionals responsible for their patch of prospective and/or existing accounts. As a member of the GTM team, your primary responsibility is to execute the key tasks that support growth across our buyside and sellside members—this includes proactively engaging with prospects and existing customers via phone and email, managing critical processes, and ensuring our systems remain accurate and up to date. You will earn our members’ trust and bolster Axial’s reputation for excellence in how we interact with prospects and existing members. Each interaction that members have with Axial should be held to the highest standards, resulting in positive resolutions and outcomes for our members. The Customer Success team is also responsible for proactive outreach to Axial members whose usage of the platform is waning or from whom we require additional information. The path to individual outperformance in this role is unlocked by mastering the ins and outs of Axial’s product and the talk tracks that let you effectively communicate our value proposition with members. You will be actively trained, developed, and coached in these areas.    Responsibilities : Understand unique member investment goals and go to market strategies to ensure they are effectively set up to see success on the platform. Drive key KPIs around member engagement with the product, through phone and email interaction. Deliver on a number of account management responsibilities, including but not limited to: Proactive prospect and member outreach to drive improved platform usage 20+ connected calls a week; promptly responding to member inbound requests via email, launching email campaigns to improve Members' usage of the Axial platform Reporting common product and service feedback to the appropriate internal teams Salesforce admin processing including contract processing and verification Help requests via phone and email Attending and participating in regular internal meetings and contributing to internal projects and initiatives as they arise   Qualifications: Up to 10 years of professional experience  2+ years of credible and demonstrated experience in a quota-carrying role within B2B sales/account management/customer success Prior exposure and GTM sales/account management/customer success experience in or around investment banking, private equity, or financial services in the North American market is a strong plus Exceptionally strong English written and oral communication skills Referenceable history of achieving increasing levels of excellence in personal or professional settings Highly responsive and organized  Tech-savvy, detail-oriented, eager to learn and flexible  Positive and professional work attitude   Working at Axial: Axial GTM employees work Eastern Time (NYC) hours and work both from the office and from home. The GTM team is based in New York (HQ), Texas, Florida, and Latin America and those in NYC work in the office three days a week. This role is a fully remote position.  When working from home, every team member must have fully reliable high-speed internet connectivity. We have a comfortable and fully functional office in Manhattan on 30th and Park. Employees based outside of New York travel to New York during the year for company-wide in-office work weeks (3 - 4 times a year).    Axial Values: Expect and Deliver Excellence - you do high-quality work consistently, and you expect it from your colleagues as well. Be an Owner - you have the personal maturity and accountability to take ownership for your work, to operate with transparency, and to focus on delivering results. Obsess over Member Trust - you work in a way that helps Axial consistently earn, grow and keep member trust. Communication Matters - you deliberately focus on being an excellent communicator and collaborator with your teammates and with members. Invent and Simplify - you are creative and curious, always looking for better ways to materially improve the quality and scalability of the member experience.   Compensation: Axial compensates based on On-Target Earnings (OTE) = Base Salary + Variable Compensation Base Salary Range: $30,000 – $60,000 USD Variable Compensations: Uncapped Other Axial benefits: Flexible PTO (recommend taking ~15 days a year + 11 US holidays) 3-4 paid trips to New York City per year Hardware / Office Equipment Stipend Individual offers are determined based on experience, qualifications, interview performance, and geographic market.

jobs.title: AI & Automation Manager, Business Operations
jobs.description: Team: Business Operations Reports to: Business Operations Lead Location: New York City In-office: 3 days per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday) About Axial Axial's mission is to unleash the power of private capital markets for entrepreneurs - and we’re doing so by pioneering an online platform that is transforming American small business M&A. Founded in 2009, Axial is an NYC-based financial technology platform that serves over 10,000 private market M&A  participants, including private equity firms, corporate acquirers, boutique investment banks, and business owners looking to sell their companies. In 2025, Axial powered the exit efforts of about half of the U.S. small and mid-sized business (SMB) M&A market - companies doing between $5M and $100M revenue - by facilitating 3,000,000+ buyer <> seller platform connections across 12,500+ deals. We're a lean, high-conviction team building category-defining products for a market that moves quickly and trusts carefully. That context shapes everything about how we work. Overview We are seeking an experienced AI & Automation Manager to design, build, and continuously improve AI-powered workflows, automations, and internal tools that transform how Axial operates. This is a highly technical, hands-on role for someone who enjoys building but is equally energized by determining what should be built, why it matters, and how it should evolve over time. Working closely with the VP of Operations and Business Operations Lead, you will help shape Axial's internal AI & Automation strategy by identifying high-impact opportunities, evaluating emerging capabilities, and translating ambiguous business challenges into scalable technical solutions. You will serve as a key technical stakeholder for AI and automation within Business Operations. Your work will span AI agents, workflow orchestration, internal applications, data infrastructure, and lightweight product development. You will build durable solutions that improve operational efficiency and create better experiences for employees and members. As AI capabilities continue to evolve, you will help Axial identify, evaluate, and apply emerging technologies that create meaningful business value. You will spend much of your time building LLM-powered solutions and working in tools such as n8n, Claude Code, Zapier, Clay, and Google Apps Script, while integrating with platforms including Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Gong, and other internal applications. Your work will range from intelligent member verification and AI-powered support to internal copilots, operational automations, and business applications that increase productivity, improve decision-making, and reduce manual work across the company. Responsibilities AI Systems Development: Build, deploy, and improve AI-powered workflows, agents, and business applications using LLMs, structured outputs, evaluations, and tools such as Claude Code and Cursor. Deliver reliable solutions for critical workflows across go-to-market, operations, and member experiences. Automation & GTM Engineering: Develop and maintain sophisticated workflows using platforms such as n8n, Zapier, Clay, and Google Apps Script. Build integrations and data processes across Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Gong, and related systems to eliminate manual work and enable GTM execution. Internal Applications & Operational Products: Create lightweight internal applications, operational tools, dashboards, copilots, and AI-powered interfaces using low-code platforms, AI-assisted development, and custom code. Deliver intuitive products that help teams work more efficiently and make better decisions. AI Architecture & Data Infrastructure: Help establish the technical and data foundations required for reliable AI & automation solutions. Connect AI models to business data and external applications using APIs, tool calling, context management, retrieval-augmented generation, MCPs, vector databases, and comparable approaches.  AI & Automation Strategy and Roadmap: Partner with Business Operations leadership to develop our AI & automation strategy and project roadmap. Evaluate emerging tools and recommend what we should prioritize to help shape Axial’s long-term operations objectives. Qualifications Experience: 5-8 years of experience designing and building technical solutions within Business Operations, GTM Engineering, RevOps, Automation, Software Engineering, or similar technical operating roles at a high-growth technology company. Interested in this work but earlier in your career? Explore our  GTM Engineer role, designed for candidates with 1-4 years of experience. Operating Experience : Experience partnering with business leaders to identify operational bottlenecks, redesign workflows, and translate business objectives into durable technical solutions. Comfortable navigating ambiguity and balancing competing priorities across multiple stakeholders. Tool Experience: Strong hands-on experience across several of the following areas: LLMs and AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code or Cursor; workflow automation platforms such as n8n, Zapier, Clay, Make, or Google Apps Script; and GTM systems such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, and Gong.  Technical Proficiency: Comfortable writing and maintaining code in JavaScript, Python, SQL, Apps Script, or similar languages to extend automations, integrations, and internal applications. Experience working with APIs, authentication, webhooks, and structured data. Systems Thinking: Demonstrated ability to decompose complex operational problems and balance speed, maintainability, reliability, security, and user experience when developing solutions. Product & Business Judgment: Able to determine not only how to build a solution, but whether it should be built, how success should be measured, and how it fits within broader business priorities and technical architecture. Ownership: History of independently leading complex initiatives from problem definition through implementation, adoption, monitoring, iteration, and long-term durability. Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communicator who can explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and build strong partnerships across both technical and business teams. Working in Business Operations Business Operations Team Work alongside the VP of Operations, Business Operations Lead, and Business Operations teammates to translate operational challenges into practical technical solutions. The team has a highly collaborative, hands-on ethos. We consistently carve out time to invest in technical upskilling, and regularly conduct AI and automation hackathons where we scope problems, prototype solutions, and learn from one another. You will contribute your technical expertise while helping raise the team's broader AI and automation capabilities. Cross-Functional Stakeholders Partner with leaders and teams across the business to understand workflows, identify opportunities, and deliver AI-powered solutions that improve business outcomes, including: VP of Product VP of GTM Data Engineering GTM Managers GTM Individual Contributors Working at Axial We are a small and tight-knit team (currently 60 employees), and you’ll have the opportunity to have a direct impact on company growth. We have a modern, well-equipped office in Manhattan on 30th and Park. The atmosphere is collegial, the office is open and inviting, and full of accommodations (kitchen, snacks, coffee, relaxing spaces, games, and an upright piano). We work hard together, but also like to have fun together, and often enjoy company events like trivia, game nights, and our annual Axialite Day. At Axial, you will also enjoy: Working with a great team of smart, motivated people Robust medical, dental, and vision insurance, paid for by Axial at nearly 100% 401k program Flexible vacation policy Paid Parental Leave Policy Monthly Health & Wellness stipend Pre-tax commuter program Below are the values we subscribe to as a company Obsess Over Member Trust : Your daily choices reflect your awareness that we facilitate vital life-altering transactions. You take this responsibility seriously and it’s top of mind. Expect and Deliver Excellence : You demonstrate consistency so that your colleagues feel confident partnering and relying on you. You demonstrate a personal commitment to continuous improvement. Communication Matters : You are concise and articulate in your communication, external or internal. You listen well and genuinely. Invent and Simplify : You are open-minded, looking for great new ideas that can elevate and even transform the member experience. You find novel ways to simplify complex status quos. Be an Owner : You think about the long-term effects of your decisions. You invest real time in building relationships with your colleagues. Below are the traits we look for and actively cultivate in every Axialite Humility: We seek truth, not credit, and learn from anyone. Positivity: We bring energy, optimism, and belief, even when it is hard. Grit: We show up, follow through, and push beyond the first draft. Discernment: We choose wisely, prioritize sharply, and ask better questions. Accountability: We take full responsibility for our work and results. NY Pay Range $175,000 — $225,000 USD
